senses.gloss: [to stretch,] (cmp. ארך) to be long, slow; to wait; esp. (of fruits taken off the tree) to lie over for complete ripening.
units: Toh. IX, 5 שיִמְתּוֹנוּ שיהו וכ׳ that they (the olives) may lie over so that they be easy to crush; ib. שימתונו שימלחם that they may lie over until they be ripe for salting; Tosef. ib. X, 10 שיַמְתִּינֵם ושימלחם (Hif.) to let them lie over &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 6:2">Makhsh. VI, 2</cite> <he>בשביל שיַמְתִּינוּ</he> (Maim. in comment. ed. Dehr. <he>שימתונו</he>) that they may remain fresh (Maim.).
Sabb. XXIII, 5 (of a corpse) בשביל שיַמְתִּין (Ar. שיִמָּתֵן, Nif.) that it may be preserved.

senses.gloss: to keep, to let (fruits) lie over. Tosef. Makhsh. l. c., v. supra.

units: <cite ref="Chullin 47b:5">Ib. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>הַמְתִּינִי לו עד וכ׳</he> postpone his circumcision until &c. Y. Pes. X, 37ᵈ <he>אילו נַמְתִּין וכ׳</he> (not <he>ממתין</he>) if we were to wait (with the recital of the exodus) until &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 18:5">Gen. R. s. 18</cite> (play on <he>יתבששו</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 2:25">Gen. II, 25</cite>) <he>לא הִמְתִּינוּ בשלותן וכ׳</he> they did not remain in their happiness for six hours; a. fr.

<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 1:4">Ab. d’R. N. ch. I</cite> <he>שיהא אדם מַמְתִּין בדבריו ואל יהא מקפיד על דבריו</he> that man should be slow and patient in giving his opinion, and not angrily insist on his words.
